name: layouts
title: Layouts
description: Full-page layouts (header, sidebar and centered) plus a sidebar navigation menu.

classes.name: header-layout
classes.description: A header row above the main area. Fills the viewport height.

classes.name: sidebar-layout
classes.description: Header, a sidebar and the main area. The sidebar shows from 48rem wide; on smaller screens use a sheet.

classes.name: closed
classes.description: On sidebar-layout: collapses the sidebar. Toggle it with toggle_class.

classes.name: centered-layout
classes.description: Centers its content in the viewport, e.g. for sign-in pages.

classes.name: container
classes.description: Centers content with a maximum width.

classes.name: sidebar-menu__content
classes.description: The scrolling middle part of the menu.

classes.name: sidebar-menu__button
classes.description: An item. Combine it with btn. Mark the current page with aria-current="page". On a <summary> it gets a disclosure chevron.

variables.name: --sidebar-width
variables.description: Width of the open sidebar (screens 48rem and wider).

attributes.name: id="header"
attributes.description: The header area of header-layout and sidebar-layout.

notes: The layouts fill 100dvh. Put the layout class on <body> or a full-height wrapper.
The header, sidebar and main areas are selected by id, so use them once per page.

examples.title: Sidebar layout
examples.description: The button in the main area toggles the closed class. On narrow screens, the menu button opens the same menu in a sheet.
